schemes.title: The Mizoram Provisional Employees Savings Scheme
schemes.description: This scheme laid out to allow the members to make defined contribution towards planned savings thereby securing the future in the form of pension. This Scheme shall be compulsory for all Provisional Employees whose | engagement is duly approved by DP&AR and Finance Department, Government of Mizoram.
schemes.benefits: - Long-Term Financial Security: The scheme allows provisional employees to make defined contributions towards planned savings, ensuring future security through a pension. - Flexible Withdrawal Options: Allows partial withdrawals for essential expenses such as higher education, marriage, housing, and medical emergencies. - Nomination Facility: Nominees are designated to receive funds in case of the employee's untimely demise. - Centralized Management: Streamlined fund management by the Nodal Office ensures effective fund utilization and accountability. | - Monthly Contributions: The DDO deducts contributions (5% of wages) from monthly salaries and remits these to the Fund Manager. | Note: Withdrawals are permitted only for education, marriage, house purchase, or medical emergencies.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Fasal Vividhikaran (Crop Diversification) Encouragement Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage crop diversification by providing necessary inputs to farmers who shift from growing wheat and paddy. Benefits are provided primarily to the implementing Company, Firm, or Institution to cover costs related to Human Resources and Marketing, benefiting farmers.
schemes.benefits: - The scheme permits the costs incurred for necessary inputs provided to farmers to inspire them towards diversification. | - The scheme primarily sanctions costs related to Human Resources (Manav Sansadhan) deployed for area overlap and Marketing (Vipanan). | - The scheme generally does not sanction Capital (Poonji) expenditure. | - Capital expenditure may be sanctioned only in special circumstances for Critical Equipment. | - Assistance from the State Government is provided for a minimum period of 3 years. | - The period of assistance may be extended based on specific needs. | - The applicant organization, if eligible for other Central Government or State Government schemes for capital investment, will be facilitated to receive such assistance.  |  Conditions | - _The implementation and monitoring of the scheme must ensure that work is carried out according to the determined directions and guidelines of the State Level Project Screening Committee (SLPSC)._ | - _The proposal submitted by the applicant must detail the viability (Vyavsayata) and provide justification (Aparikshan) for the Proposed Expenditures (Prastavit Vyay)._ | - _If the applicant Company, Firm, or Institution violates the conditions of the sanction, especially the terms of the Detailed Project Report (DPR), provision will be made for regulatory action or recovery of funds._
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a Company, Firm, or Institution.; The applicant must maintain all records and qualifications as a qualifying Company, Firm, or Institution.; The applicant must advise the farmer regarding the sowing of the 'Eligible Crop' and the associated Agriculture Practice (Krishi Karyapranali).; The applicant must confirm the purchase of the 'Eligible Crop'.; The applicant must execute the crop diversification work.; The applicant must make a mandatory tie-up with another Company, Firm, or Institution for the purchase of the 'Eligible Crop'.; The applicant must ensure they themselves do not purchase the crop.; The Eligible Crop must be any crop, excluding wheat (Gehun) and paddy (Dhan), that is sown in place of wheat and paddy.; The Eligible Crop must not be covered under Minimum Support Price (MSP).; Horticultural crops must also be included in the Eligible Crops.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Janani Suraksha Yojana
schemes.description: Under this scheme, cash incentives are provided to pregnant women and their motivators for delivery in government or accredited private hospitals.
schemes.benefits: Financial Assistance: | - ₹1,400 to rural pregnant women delivering in government or accredited private hospitals. | - ₹1,000 to urban pregnant women for institutional delivery. | - ₹350 incentive to the motivator (ASHA or escort) assisting a rural woman for delivery. | - ₹200 incentive to the motivator (ASHA or escort) assisting an urban woman for delivery. | - ₹250 as transport allowance, if the motivator or family arranges transportation to the hospital. | - Free hospital stay and maternal health services in government or accredited private hospitals.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant should be a pregnant woman.; The applicant should deliver in a government or accredited private hospital.; The applicant should belong to a BPL (Below Poverty Line) or Antyodaya family.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Disability Assistance
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to physically disabled artists and litterateurs for disability-related medical treatment and rehabilitation.
schemes.benefits: - One-time financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/-. | - Assistance is provided exclusively for the treatment of physical disability. | NOTE: Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant should be a physically disabled artist or litterateur.; The applicant should be 21 years of age or above.; The applicant’s monthly income from all sources, including spouse income, should not exceed ₹10,000.; The total monthly family income, including dependents, should not exceed ₹20,000.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to the dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs.
schemes.benefits: - One-time ex-gratia financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 paid to the legal heir of the deceased artist or litterateur. | NOTE: | - Preference is given to the spouse of the deceased. | - Assistance may continue to other dependents until marriage, employment, or attainment of 21 years of age, whichever is earlier.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be the legal heir or dependent of the deceased artist or litterateur.; The deceased should have been an artist or litterateur of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant’s (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed ₹10,000/-.; The family’s monthly income should not exceed ₹20,000/-.; Families of government employees are not eligible.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance for serious illness, accident, or calamity-related medical treatment to artists and litterateurs.

schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be an artist or a litterateur.; The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant should be suffering from a serious or long-term illness, accident, or calamity.; The applicant’s (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed ₹10,000.; The total family income should not exceed ₹20,000 per month.; The writer/artist's fully dependent spouse, fully dependent parents, dependent minor brothers and sisters, dependent minor children, dependent widowed daughter, and dependent differently-abled brothers and sisters are eligible to get assistance.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide for the management of tree covered areas located on private land and revenue land under the MP Public Forestry Act, 2001. The scheme benefits landowners, Gram Panchayats, or Gram Sabhas by allowing them to undertake the scientific management of their tree covered areas.
schemes.benefits: - Authorization for scientific management of tree-covered areas.  |  Conditions | - _The designated Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must implement the Technical Management Plan according to the activities and conditions specified within the plan._ | - _For "Lok Van" (Public Forest) management plans, the Gram Sabha must authorize the implementation of the specified activities through a resolution of the Social Audit Committee._ | - _If the management plan involves harvesting timber, the concerned Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must provide advance notification regarding the proposed date of harvesting to the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari) or Tehsildar, at least seven days prior to the proposed date._ | - _The Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must maintain a register regarding the trees harvested, using the prescribed format within the Technical Management Plan._ | - _All subsequent operations and transactions mentioned in the Technical Management Plan must be completed within the stipulated time._ | - _The implementation of the approved Technical Management Plan will be monitored by the Competent Authority (Samyak Pradhikari) through a committee or other authorized official under the supervision of the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari)._ | - _The approval of the Technical Management Plan may be revoked if there is a violation of the defined conditions or rules._
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a landowner who desires to take responsibility for the management of any tree covered area.; The applicant must be a Gram Panchayat or a Gram Sabha who desires to take responsibility for the management of any tree covered revenue land located within its jurisdiction.; The applicant must apply to the Tehsildar (Revenue) for the demarcation and management of the land as "Lok Van" (Public Forest), if the land is tree covered revenue land.; The applicant must submit the management proposal to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) or the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari).; The applicant (Landowner) must attach a declaration regarding land title/possession, including an attested photocopy of the latest land records (Khasra).; The applicant (Gram Panchayat/Gram Sabha) must submit a resolution to the Tehsildar (Revenue) after getting the land demarcated and handed over for management as "Lok Van".

schemes.title: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste students in standards 9 to 12. Through this scheme, eligible SC students receive free boarding, lodging, textbooks, uniforms, meals, and additional support services to enhance academic participation.

schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a student.; The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.; The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.; The applicant must be currently studying in standard 9th to 12th in a recognized institution.1. schemes.title: Monthly Pension for the Maintenance of the Parents of the Martyred Soldier of the Army
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹10,000 per month to the dependent parents of martyred soldiers for their maintenance and livelihood.
schemes.benefits: - A pension of ₹10,000 per month is provided to the parents of martyred soldiers.
schemes.eligibility: The martyred soldier must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant must be the mother or father of a martyred soldier.; The martyred soldier whose death has been recognized as a battle casualty by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.; The annual income of the applicant's parents must be less than ₹10,000.

schemes.title: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.
schemes.benefits: Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided: | - Pasteurized compost is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 50 quintals per beneficiary. Similarly, mushroom spawn (seed) is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 25 kg per beneficiary. No cash is given; the pasteurized compost and spawn are provided directly by the department. | - Seven-day training for mushroom growers is provided (₹1,050/- per beneficiary), of which ₹700/- is transferred to the beneficiary’s account through DBT, and ₹350/- is used for training materials and related expenses. | - Farmers/mushroom growers who produce mushrooms under the scheme can sell their produce in local markets or mandis.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.; The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom cultivation.

schemes.title: Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
schemes.description: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community" was launched by the Mizoram Scholarship Board, Government of Mizoram. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes pursuing post-matriculation.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance is provided to the students. | _*The scheme is funded by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Government of Mizoram in 90:10 ratio._
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be permanently settled in Mizoram.; The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste.; The income of the parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- per annum.; The applicant's ongoing educational qualification must be between 11th Standard and Post-Doctoral Fellowship.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Non-Government Institution Grant Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to support non-government cultural institutions by providing financial grants for cultural activities, training, equipment, and events.
schemes.benefits: Types of Financial Assistance | Maintenance Grant | - Provided for training activities and art performances. | - Annual recurring grant. | - Maximum assistance up to 90% of the approved project or activity cost. | Equipment Grant | - Provided for the purchase of books, musical instruments, audio-visual equipment, electrical equipment, furniture, cameras, record players, and workshop tools. | - Non-recurring grant. | - Maximum assistance up to 90% of the actual expenditure. | Camp and Event Grant | - Provided for training camps, cultural camps, and special cultural or literary events. | - Maximum assistance up to 90% of the proposed total expenditure.

schemes.title: Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana
schemes.description: "Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana
schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Pragatisheel Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana" is an initiative under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aimed to encourage the trend of rearing indigenous breed of cows with high quality and productivity in the state & motivate cattle farmers for breed improvement of cows, their better care.

schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme
