schemes.title: Pension Scheme - Folk Artist
schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a pension to the registered folk artists.
schemes.benefits: - Pension of ₹300/- per month.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a registered folk artist.; The applicant's age should be 60 years or above.; The artist must have worked continuously in their profession for at least five years.; Disabled folk artists (sick and unable to work) who are under 60 but have been registered with the board for five continuous years are eligible for a pension.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender
schemes.description: The 'Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to help poor transgender above 40 years of age who are unable to earn their livelihood.
schemes.benefits: - Pension of ₹ 1,000/- per month.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be Transgender.; The applicant should be destitute.; The applicant's age should be 40 years and above.; The applicant should be physically unable to work and earn.; The applicant should not have received assistance from any family member or other sources.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients
schemes.description: The scheme "Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients" is a Pension Scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000/- per month to Leprosy Patients who are residents of Tripura.
schemes.benefits: Pension of ₹2,000/- per month.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.; The applicant should be affected with Leprosy Grade II.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Transgender
schemes.description: Launched on 1st August 2015, the scheme "Pension Scheme for Transgender" is a Pension Scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000/- to the transgender residents of Tripura who have no source of income.
schemes.benefits: - ₹2,000/- per month.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.; The applicant should be Transgender.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme for the Journalists
schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme for the Journalists" was launched by the Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give a monthly pension to retired journalists.
schemes.benefits: - Pension Amount of ₹4,000/- per month.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a retired journalist.; The age of the applicant should be 58 years or above.; The applicant should have worked full-time for 20 years in one of the posts of teacher, assistant teacher, reporter, photographer, proofreader, or news correspondent.; 10 years of journalism experience is sufficient if the applicant is terminally ill or physically disabled.; The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹20,000/-.; The applicant received gratuity and pension from previous companies should not exceed ₹30,000/-.; In any year when the applicant was employed, their income should not exceed ₹50,000/-.

schemes.title: PURNA Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to reduce malnutrition, anemia, and early marriage among adolescent girls in Gujarat by educating them on health, nutrition, life skills, and legal rights, while promoting self-empowerment through various activities.
schemes.benefits: - Nutritional Support: Supplementary nutrition (PURNA Shakti) 4 packets (1kg/packet) on 4th Tuesday of every month which contains 9 micronutrients. - Health Enhancement: Distribution of IFA tablets every Wednesday at schools and AWCs, along with health check-ups and referral services, is conducted in convergence with the Health Department. - Educational Encouragement: Support out of school adolescent girls for school re-enrollment and vocational training. - Life Skill Development: Knowledge of nutrition, health, and legal rights. - Public Exposure: Visit at public places (Primary health centre, Bank, Post office and any government offices etc.) for their self-empowerment). - Awareness Programs: Celebration of PURNA divas at Anganwadi centres on the 4th Tuesday of every month where various theme based activities are carried out based on health, nutrition and self -development of adolescent girls. - Empowerment Kits: Distribution of PURNA kit at Anganwadi centres for awareness about nutrition, health and empowerment among adolescent girls.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a girl.; The applicant must be aged between 15-18 years.; Applicant must be enrolled at an Anganwadi center in Gujarat.
schemes.category: Health & Wellness; Women and Child; Education & Learning

schemes.title: Parivahan Scheme (GBCDC)
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for vehicle purchases in the transport sector for SEBC unemployed individuals. A loan is provided under the scheme.
schemes.benefits: - The applicant can avail a loan of up to ₹2,00,000/- for purchasing vehicles such as auto-rickshaws, loading vehicles, and other transport vehicles.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) category.; The applicant can be of any gender.; The applicant should be unemployed.; The applicant should have any level of education.; The applicant should have an individual and family annual income up to ₹3,00,000/-.; The applicant should hold a valid Driving Licence for the type of vehicle intended for purchase (specifically for passenger vehicles).

schemes.title: Poshan Sudha
schemes.description: This scheme is a government initiative to provide nutrition and healthcare support to pregnant and lactating mothers in tribal districts of Gujarat.
schemes.benefits: - Nutritional Support: Provision of one full nutritious meal daily for pregnant and lactating mothers. Supply of iron and calcium supplements to address nutritional deficiencies. - Health Education: Awareness sessions on health and nutrition for better maternal and child care.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.; The applicant must be a pregnant or lactating woman residing in one of the tribal districts of Gujarat.; The applicant must be registered in a local Anganwadi center.

schemes.title: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
schemes.description: A scholarship scheme by MoE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical degree course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for max. 4 years for first-year admitted students and max. 3 years for second-year admitted students through lateral entry.
schemes.benefits: ₹ 50,000/- per annum for every year of study, i.e. maximum of 4 years for first-year admitted students and a maximum of 3 years for second-year admitted students, through lateral entry as a lump sum amount towards payment of college fees, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipment, software, etc.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a **Girl Student.**1. The applicant must be pursuing either **the First year of the degree course** OR **the Second year of the Degree course through lateral entry.**1. The **annual income of the family** (from all sources) must not be more than **₹ 8,00,000/- per annum** during the current financial year.1. **All eligible girls** (who submit online scholarship form) **from the following 13 Union Territories and North Eastern States** i.e. Andaman and Nicobar Islands (UT), Jammu and Kashmir (UT), Ladakh (UT), Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu (UT), Lakshadweep (UT), Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim & Tripura will be given a scholarship by AICTE.
schemes.category: Education & Learning; Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
schemes.description: A scholarship scheme by AICTE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical diploma course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for a period of max. of 3 years for first-year students and a max. of 2 years for second-year admitted students (later entry).
schemes.benefits: ₹ 50,000/- per annum for every year of study, i.e. maximum 3 years for first-year admitted students and maximum 2 years for second-year admitted students, through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipment, software, etc. No other additional grant will be payable instead of hostel charges medical charges, etc.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a **Girl Student.**1. The applicant must be pursuing either **the First year of the Diploma course** OR **the** **Second year of the Diploma course through lateral entry.**1. The **annual income of the family** (from all sources) must not be more than **₹ 8,00,000 per annum** during the current financial year.1. **All eligible girls** (who submit an online scholarship form) **from the following 13 Union Territories and North Eastern States** i.e., Andaman and Nicobar Islands (UT), Jammu and Kashmir (UT), Ladakh (UT), Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu (UT), Lakshadweep (UT), Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, & Tripura will be given a scholarship by AICTE.
schemes.category: Education & Learning; Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Pragati Scholarship (81 for Uttarakhand girl students (Diploma) and 50 for Graduation)
schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girl students of the state by providing financial assistance in the form of scholarship. Under this scheme, scholarships are awarded to 81 girl students enrolled in Diploma courses and 50 girl students enrolled in Graduation courses in Uttarakhand.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum is provided for girl students at the Diploma and Graduation levels.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a girl student.; The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.; The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.; A maximum of two girl children are allowed per family to avail of this scholarship.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme (HBOCWWB)
schemes.description: Under this scheme, a member of the fund who has been working as a building worker for not less than three years shall on completion of sixty years of age be eligible for a pension of ₹3,250/- per month.
schemes.benefits: - Under this scheme, a registered construction worker is given a pension of ₹3,250/- per month after the age of 60 years.
schemes.eligibility: Applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.; The registered worker must have a minimum of three years of regular membership before completing the age of 60 years.; The registered worker should not be availing the pension benefits from any other Department/Board/Corporation of the Haryana Government.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme" by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Himachal Pradesh provides registered beneficiaries with a minimum pension of ₹1,000/- per month upon reaching 60 years of age.
schemes.benefits: Pension amount ₹1,000/- per month.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.; The applicant must be a Building or Construction Worker.; The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.; The applicant should have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months.; The registration must be renewed annually.; The worker should be registered as a Building or Construction worker with the "Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".; The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active.; The worker should be 60 years of age or older.; The beneficiary should have been a continuous member of the Board for three years before attaining the age of 60 years.

schemes.title: Provision of Sports Kits to Players Participating at the National Level
schemes.description: This scheme provides a sports kit worth ₹5000/- (including tracksuit, jersey, shorts, socks, etc.) to approximately 1000 players annually who participate in various sports at the national level, selected through their respective sports federations.
schemes.benefits: - Under this scheme, sports kits are provided through sports associations to players and team members participating in various sports disciplines at the national level across different age groups. | - Approximately 1,000 players benefit from the scheme annually.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a player or a member of a team representing Uttarakhand.; The applicant or their team must be participating in national-level sports competitions.

schemes.title: Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent (Class - 11 To 12)
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the meritorious Higher Secondary School Students of Odisha having proficiency in Mathematics.
schemes.benefits: - The students of Class XI and XII fulfilling the eligibility criteria will receive ₹5,000/- per month for 10 months in a year. | - A student may enjoy more than one scholarship at a time, including PSMTS.
schemes.eligibility: The student pursuing his/her studies in Class XI and XII in Higher Secondary Schools affiliated to Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha.; The students have proficiency in Mathematics.; The candidate must belong to the General, SC, ST, OBC/SEBC & EBC categories.; The scheme is applicable to students reading in Odia Medium Higher Secondary Schools affiliated to CHSE(O).; There shall be no income criteria for the award of this scholarship.

schemes.title: Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana
schemes.description: The "Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana" was initiated to provide shelter for stray male cattle by constructing infrastructure in Panchayat Samitis.
schemes.benefits: - One-time assistance of 90% of the total construction cost.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible entities include local bodies, Panchayati Raj institutions, registered trusts, NGOs, and government-recognized institutions.; The organization must have been operational for at least 3 years.; Ownership of 20 bighas of private land to sustain 250 male cattle.; Minimum of 3 years of experience in operating a cattle shelter or similar activities.; Availability of 10% contribution towards the project cost.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)
schemes.state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to eligible senior citizens to cater to their basic needs. The scheme benefits senior citizens aged 60 years and above, providing a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- for those aged 60–69 years and ₹2,000/- for those aged 70 years and above.
schemes.benefits: Quantum & Nature of Assistance: | - Senior citizens aged 60–69 years: Monthly pension of ₹1,500/-. | - Senior citizens aged 70 years and above: Monthly pension of ₹2,000/-. | Note: The mode of fund transfer shall be Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a domicile of the Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.; The applicant should be 60 years or older.; The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.; The applicant should not be receiving financial assistance under any other old age pension scheme.

schemes.title: Prathibha Scholarship Programme
schemes.description: Prathibha Scholarship Programme is aimed at motivating bright Students to higher studies in Science by awarding Scholarships. Prathibha Scholars are also provided opportunities to attend Science Orientation Programmes and interact with pioneers in Science through the SPEED Scheme.

schemes.title: Power Subsidy Scheme
schemes.description: Launched in 2018, the objective and the scope of the "Power Subsidy Scheme" of the Dept of IT, Govt of Goa, is to provide Power Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in the State of Goa. All the New and Existing Units having their operations in Goa are eligible for this scheme.
schemes.benefits: - 20% subsidy on power bills (on the power charges, excluding any duty and taxes, but not on the total bill), subject to a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000 per annum per Unit whichever is lower. | - The subsidy will be provided for a period of 3 years from the date of commencement of operations or from the date of notification of this policy whichever is later. | NOTE 1: The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation. No Promissory Estoppel shall be applicable if benefits are discontinued in case the allocation is exceeded. | NOTE 2: Only expenditure incurred during the operation of the Policy will be eligible for the rebate.
schemes.eligibility: Proprietorship Firm; Private Limited Company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (or equivalent); Public Limited Company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (or equivalent); Registered Partnership Firm incorporated under the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (or equivalent); Limited Liability Partnership incorporated under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008 (or equivalent)

schemes.title: Price Support Scheme
schemes.description: The Government's price policy for agricultural commodities seeks to ensure remunerative prices to the growers for their produce with a view to encourage higher investment and production and to safeguard the interest of consumers by making available supplies at reasonable prices.
schemes.eligibility: 1)	Farmers get the benefit of the scheme by selling their produce at support price in APMC centers opened by the Nodal procurement agency. | 2)	Farmers belong to Assam State. | 3)	Government employees are not allowed to apply to the scheme.

schemes.title: Post SSC Scholarship for Boys/Girls from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Socially & Educationally Backward Classes and Nomadic & De-notified Tribes pursuing education after SSC. Under this scheme, eligible students receive yearly scholarships ranging from ₹1,500 to ₹5,000, depending on their academic group.
schemes.benefits: - Yearly scholarship of ₹1,500/- to ₹5,000/- depending on the academic group (Group A to D).
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.; The applicant should be a student who has passed the SSC examination.; The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) or a Notified Tribe or De-Notified Tribe (NTDNT) community of Gujarat.; The annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- for boys.

schemes.title: Pre-SSC Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Parixitlal Majmudar Scholarship)
schemes.description: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Scheduled Caste students who are studying in Class 1 to 10 in Government/Grant-in-Aid Schools/Private Schools.

schemes.eligibility: The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category of Gujarat.; The student should be enrolled in Standards 1 to 10.; There is no income limit for the scheme.

schemes.title: Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts
schemes.description: The scheme "Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage the publication of fine arts books through financial assistance provided to artists and art institutions.
schemes.benefits: - Financial Assistance: 50% of the total printing cost or a maximum of ₹20,000/- (whichever is lower).
schemes.eligibility: An individual artist or an art institution working in the field of fine arts is eligible for this scheme.

schemes.title: Prize Schemes to the Students (State Level Prizes)
schemes.description: The scheme awards students from Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) for their excellent performance in academic exams studying in Government/Government Aided and Private Schools.
schemes.benefits: - First Prize: ₹50,000/- (boys from BC), ₹25,000/- (girls from BC) - Second Prize: ₹30,000/- (boys from BC), ₹20,000/- (girls from BC) - Third Prize: ₹20,000/- (boys from BC), ₹15,000/- (girls from BC)
schemes.eligibility: The beneficiary should be a student.; The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.; The beneficiary should belong to the Backward Classes (BC)/ Most Backward Classes (MBC)/ Denotified Communities (DNC).; The beneficiary should be studying in a Government/ Government Aided/ Private School.; The beneficiary must have studied Tamil as the first language.

schemes.title: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Parityakta Pension Yojana
schemes.description: Under the Scheme, Madhya Pradesh government provides financial benefits to Be from a family living below the poverty line.
schemes.benefits: Pension Benefits : ₹ 600/- per month
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.; The Abandoned women aged between 18 to 59 years.; The applicant should be living below the poverty line.; The applicant name should be mentioned on the Samagr portal.

schemes.title: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme
schemes.description: The "Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme" by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000 per month to each Gram Panchayat for operational and maintenance purposes, ensuring efficient governance at the grassroots level.
schemes.benefits: - A monthly grant of ₹15,000 per Gram Panchayat for operational expenses.  |  NOTE: Electronic fund transfer mechanism for timely disbursement every quarter.
schemes.eligibility: The Gram Panchayats must within the state of Jharkhand.; The Gram Panchayat must have an operational Panchayat Secretariat in place to receive and utilize the grant.; The Gram Panchayat must maintain proper records, documentation, and reconciliation of expenditures to continue receiving support under the scheme.

schemes.title: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
schemes.description: The scheme “Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations” was launched by the Rubber Board, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India to motivate tappers and retain them in the tapping job.
schemes.benefits: - The enrolled member who remits their annual contribution continuously up to the age of 60 years will get a pension of ₹1300/- per month. | - The members are also eligible for other benefits like family pension, financial assistance for permanent disability, Maternity Benefits, Medical Assistance, etc., and also other benefits as decided by the Government from time to time. | - The scheme ensures a regular pension after the age of 60 years.
schemes.eligibility: A tapper aged between 18 to 55 years and having an experience of 90 days in the preceding 12 months.; Engaged in tapping jobs throughout the year in small rubber plantations for wages or engaged in self-tapping in own small rubber plantation up to 1 ha.; The tappers should be certified under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) of PMKVY of the Government of India or any training conducted by the Rubber Board for skill up-gradation (TSS, TISP).; Tappers enrolled in the tapper bank under Rubber Producers Societies (RPS) are also eligible for enrolment.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Banking,Financial Services and Insurance

schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Widow
schemes.state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, aims to provide financial assistance to widows aged between 18-59 years. The scheme offers ₹1,000/- per month to help meet their basic needs, ensuring public assistance for widows in need of support to maintain a dignified life.
schemes.benefits: - Under this scheme, widows receive financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month. | Note: The mode of fund transfer shall be Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a domicile of the Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.; The applicant should be a widow.; The applicant should be between 18 and 59 years of age.; The benefit will be discontinued if the applicant remarries or enters a live-in relationship.; The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹1.5 lakh.; The applicant should not be receiving financial assistance under any other widow pension scheme.
schemes.category: Women and Child; Social welfare & Empowerment

schemes.title: Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
schemes.description: The Rajasthan Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to pregnant women from registered construction worker families in the state
schemes.benefits: - The birth of a daughter: ₹ 21,000/- | - The birth of a son : ₹ 20,000/- | - In case of not receiving cash benefits under Janani Suraksha Yojana, ₹1,000/- additional assistance will be payable.
schemes.eligibility: The female worker must be holding a beneficiary identity card under Section 13 of the Maternity Benefit Act.; The age of the female beneficiary should not be less than 20 years at the time of delivery.; Maternity benefits will be payable for a maximum of two deliveries only. schemes.title: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (General Stream)
schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (General Stream) and have obtained 75% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching fees, as per merit prepared at state level up to 100 students.
schemes.benefits: Assistance Details: | •	Standard 11th: ₹8,000/- per annum as a private tuition fees | •	Standard 12th: ₹4,000/- per annum as a private tuition fees
schemes.eligibility: The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.; The student should be studying in Standard 11th & 12th General Stream.; The student should have 75% or more marks in Standard 10th.; The annual family income of the student should be up to ₹4.50 lakhs.

schemes.title: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream)
schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (Science Stream) and have obtained 70% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching.
schemes.benefits: Assistance Details: | •	11th Standard: ₹15,000/- per annum as a private tuition fees | •	12th Standard: ₹15,000/- per annum as a private tuition fees
schemes.eligibility: The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.; The student should be studying in Standard 11th & 12th Science Stream.; The student should have 70% or more marks in Standard 10th.; The annual family income of the student should be up to ₹6 lakhs.

schemes.title: Private Tuition Assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying in Science Stream of Class 11 & 12
schemes.description: Under this scheme, a grant of ₹15,000 each for class 11 and class 12 to cover private tuition fees for eligible SEBC students pursuing science education in higher secondary classes.
schemes.benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹15,000 for Class 11th- Financial assistance of ₹15,000 for Class 12th
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.; The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC).; The applicant must be studying in the science stream in Class 11th or Class 12th in a recognized higher secondary school.1. The applicant must be availing of private tuition during the academic year.; The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.

schemes.title: Popular Tiatr Competition

schemes.title: Promotion of Tribal Culture
schemes.description: The scheme provides financial grants (up to ₹3,00,000/- per organization) to registered NGOs/Trusts/Voluntary Organizations for promoting tribal culture among ST(P) communities in Assam's plain districts (outside BTC).
schemes.benefits: Financial Grant: Maximum of ₹3,00,000/- per organization for tribal culture promotion initiatives (e.g., heritage, literature, local brews). | Disbursement: Subject to Selection Committee approval and fund availability. | _*Financial assistance is not a right; approval depends on eligibility and fund availability._
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a Registered NGO/Trust/Voluntary Organization under the Societies Registration Act, 1980, or equivalent.; The applicant must have a demonstrated background in promoting tribal culture.

schemes.title: Plastic Tunnel (Lo-Tunnel)
schemes.description: Plastic tunnels (low tunnels) provide benefits to farmers. These are protected structures created by covering each crop bed with a low-lying plastic sheet after the crops have been planted in the main field.
schemes.benefits: - 50 percent subsidy is available for a maximum of 1000 square meters. | - Small/marginal category farmers are given a 75 percent subsidy for a maximum of 4000 square meters.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.; The applicant should be a farmer.; The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.

schemes.title: Paddy Transplantor Machine se Dhan Ropayee par Anudan
schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote mechanized paddy transplantation under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. It provides ₹3,000 per acre for land preparation, including ploughing and weeding, up to 2 hectares.
schemes.benefits: (A) Field Preparation Expenditure per Hectare: | - Field Ploughing (5 hours @ ₹700 per hour): ₹3,500/- | - Field Weeding (6 hours with Rotavator @ ₹700 per hour): ₹4,200/- | - Total Field Preparation Cost: ₹7,700/- | (B) Expenditure for Seedling Preparation per Hectare: | - Plastic Sheet for Nursery (15 Kg @ ₹100 per Kg): ₹1,500/- | - Field Weeding (6 hours with Rotavator @ ₹500 per hour): ₹3,000/- | - Other Expenses (Soil, Manure, Sand, Water - arranged by the farmer): Not Included | - Additional Contingencies: ₹500/- | - Total Seedling Preparation Cost: ₹5,000/- | Total Expenditure per Hectare: | - Field Preparation (A) + Seedling Preparation (B): ₹7,700 + ₹5,000 = ₹12,500/- per hectare | - Cost per Acre: ₹5,080/- | Subsidy Details: | - Subsidy Amount: 75% of the cost | - Maximum Subsidy Limit: ₹3,800/- per acre
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a farmer residing in the Chhattisgarh.; The applicant should be engaged in paddy cultivation.; The applicant should be willing to use a paddy transplanter machine for transplantation.; The applicant should be preparing a mat-type nursery for paddy transplantation.; The applicant should have suitable land for ploughing and weeding.; The applicant should have a cultivable area of up to 2 hectares to be eligible for the grant.

schemes.title: Payment in the Owner-Occupied / Public Forestry Case
schemes.description: Under this scheme, farmers are enabled to sell teak and sal wood to the government at notified rates, ensuring fair compensation through timely e-payment.
schemes.benefits: - Farmers receive timely payment for the sale of their legally owned teak and sal wood. | - Payment is made within 45 working days if sold at government rates and within 30 working days if sold through a separate lot after full recovery. | - Ensures fair market value and legal compliance for forest produce sales. | - Payments are made directly to the farmer’s bank account through e-payment. | Expected Time of Disbursement: | - 45 working days from the date of timber receipt in the depot (if sold at Government rate). | - 30 working days from the date of full sale value realization (if sold through a separate lot).
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant should be a registered Malik Makbuza (private forest owner) or Lok Vaniki farmer.; The sale must involve only specified forest produce such as teak (sagwan) and sal.

schemes.title: A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops
schemes.description: This scheme offers 90% financial assistance to farmers for purchasing planting materials of fruit crops to promote horticulture.
schemes.benefits: - Farmers receive up to 90% financial assistance on the cost of planting materials. | Pre-fixed assistance rates per hectare for different crops:  |  Fruit Assistance Mango₹32,000/haSapota (Chiku)₹22,000/haPomegranate₹20,000/haGuava₹16,650/haAonla (Indian Gooseberry)₹5,560/haMandarin / Orange₹5,560/haBer₹2,780/haCoconut₹13,000/ha | Note: | - Only saplings costing up to ₹250/- per unit are eligible for subsidy. | - For fruit crops and cuttings: Planting material will have to be purchased from nurseries accredited by NHB/Agricultural University/Horticulture Department.- For coconut crops: seedlings prepared from seeds will have to be purchased from nurseries accredited by NHB/Agricultural University/Horticulture Department.- For tissue culture: Planting material (planting) will have to be purchased from tissue labs approved/accredited by DBT, GNFC, GSFC, Tissue Labs of Agricultural University, Government Public Institutions like
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a farmer.; The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.; The applicant must purchase planting materials from approved/accredited sources.

schemes.title: Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities
schemes.description: The scheme aims to support institutions and individuals to organize tiatr-related cultural activities in Goa. It provides financial assistance for Konkani musical shows, competitions, and programs celebrating tiatr artists.
schemes.benefits: Financial Support Categories | - Category A1 - Konkani Musical Shows: Financial assistance for organizing shows with minimum 14 songs including duets, trios, quartets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits.- Category A2 - Singing Competitions: Financial assistance for organizing competitions with minimum 15 participants singing newly composed kantaram.- Category B1 - Competitions: Financial assistance for acting competitions including monologue, dialogue, and one act play competitions.- Category B2 - Celebrating Tiatr Artists: Financial assistance for organizing programs to remember and felicitate prominent tiatr artists. | Conditions | - Programs must be staged free of charge to the public. | - All promotional materials must acknowledge collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa. | - Backdrop of minimum size 6 feet x 10 feet displaying Tiatr Academy of Goa logo is mandatory. | - No adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion permitted. | - Chief Guest and Guest of Honour must be decided in consultation with Tiatr Academy of Goa. | - President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will be the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual organizing tiatr-related activities in Goa.; The applicant must organize activities in their respective villages or towns.; The applicant must ensure the program is staged free of charge to the public.; The applicant must agree to acknowledge Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all promotional materials.; The applicant must ensure content does not contain adverse remarks against governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion.; The applicant must ensure lyrics are newly composed and not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums.; The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments.; The applicant must organize minimum 14 songs including interactive duets, duos, trios, quartets/quintets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits.; The applicant must submit typed lyrics and skit scripts at least 30 days in advance.; The applicant must ensure minimum 15 participants.; The applicant must ensure participants sing newly composed kantaram not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums.; The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments.; The applicant must provide competition rules to Tiatr Academy of Goa.; The applicant must submit typed song lyrics at least 8 days in advance.; The applicant must submit application form at least 30 days in advance.; The applicant must focus on prominent tiatr artists such as actors, singers, writers.; The applicant must submit application form at least 15 days in advance.

schemes.title: Providing Tin stalls to Gatai Kamgar
schemes.description: "Providing Tin Stalls to Gatai Kamgar" is a social welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance of the Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Caste individuals engaged in leather footwear production and leather goods preparation.
schemes.benefits: ₹500/- is provided as financial assistance.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.; The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra.; If the applicant resides in a rural area, his/her total household income should be less than ₹40,000.; If the applicant resides in an urban area, his/her total household income should be less than ₹50,000.; The applicant should be 18 years or above in age.; The place where the applicant asking for the stall must be provided on rent/ lease/purchased/official free hand by Gram panchayat, Municipality, Cantonment Board or Municipal corporation or must be of own property of the applicant.
schemes.category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance; Business & Entrepreneurship

schemes.title: Promotion of Tiatr Through Academic Activities
schemes.description: The scheme aims to foster interest in Tiatr among students and enthusiasts through academic activities like talks, symposia, seminars, and workshops. It covers activity expenditures, honorarium for resource persons, and provides materials, benefiting educational institutions and individuals.
schemes.benefits: • Awareness Creation: Awareness about Tiatr, its song, and music will be created through academic activities such as talks, symposia, seminars, and workshops. | • Resource Person Honorarium: Resource persons will be paid an honorarium, as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa, for every session, with the amount dependent upon the distance from their residence to the venue. | • Expenditure Coverage: The Tiatr Academy of Goa will cover the expenditure incurred on Resource Persons, refreshments, and food (lunch or dinner) served to participants. Additionally, any other miscellaneous expenditure made in organizing the activity by an institution or individual by way of collaboration will be taken care of by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. | • Provision of Materials: The Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide essential materials, including a backdrop, certificates for the participants, and stationery. | • Documentation Coverage: The Tiatr Academy of Goa will document the Symposia, Seminar, or Workshop, and the expenditure incurred on this documentation will be borne by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. | Conditions | _Prior approval will be required from the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing the resource persons, if the activity is organized in collaboration with others._ | _The cost of refreshments or food to be served must be verified and approved by the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalization._ | _The scheme will be implemented strictly on a ‘First Come First Serve’ basis._ | _Applications will be considered, and benefits disbursed as per the availability of funds._
schemes.eligibility: • The applicant must be an educational institution or an individual interested in collaborating with the Tiatr Academy of Goa to organize academic activities for promoting Tiatr. | • The applicant must ensure the number of participants for conducting the Symposia, Seminar, or Workshop shall be at least 20. | • The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing resource persons, if the activity is organized by others in collaboration. | • The applicant must get the cost of refreshments or food to be served verified and approved by the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing them.

schemes.title: Pension to Unmarried Poor, Incapacitated Women of Age 50 years and above
schemes.description: The 'Pension to Unmarried Poor, Incapacitated Women of age 50 years and above' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a pension of ₹1,000/- to unmarried, poor, incapacitated women of age 50 years and above.
schemes.benefits: Pension: | - ₹1,000/- per month. | Free Clothes during Pongal and Deepavali: | - One free saree. | Free Rice in Anganwadi Centres: | - 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meals. | - 4kg/month to those who are not taking nutritious meals.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a woman.; The applicant should be destitute.; The applicant should be unmarried.; The applicant's age should be 50 years and above.; The applicant's fixed assets should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Prime Tourism Vehicle Scheme-Meghalaya
schemes.description: The scheme boosts tourism by providing 50% financial assistance for adventure tourism vehicles, along with easy credit, operator training, and GPS and branding support.
schemes.benefits: - 50% of on-road vehicle cost supported (5% by the entrepreneur, 45% by the Government of Meghalaya) | - 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months | - Credit linkage through partnered banks | - Pre-fitted GPS device with 5-year warranty (cost borne by Government, one-time) | - Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government (first time only) | - Mandatory capacity building and training programs under Meghalaya Tourist Operator Program (MTOTP) by the Tourism Department | - Support from PRIME – Tourism Vehicle Cell for promotion, grievance redressal, and training | - Eligibility for multiple vehicle types, including 8–17 seater luxury buses, 4x4 vehicles, and MPVs for tourism and adventure tourism
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age.; The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.; The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license.; The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector.; The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle.; The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.; The applicant should be a recognised and registered tour operator, tourism society, or similar entity based in Meghalaya.; The applicant should have experience in the tourism sector.; The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle.; The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme.; The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.; The applicant should provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate, as applicable.; The applicant should be an unregistered entity such as a village organization, self-help group, or traditional community based in Meghalaya.; The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector.; The applicant should provide certification from the Block Development Officer (BDO) to support involvement in the tourism sector.; The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme.; The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.

schemes.title: Production of Tiatr in Villages/Urban Areas/Educational Institutions
schemes.description: The scheme aims to explore and develop hidden singing and acting talents among youths in villages by promoting tiatr activities. It provides financial and technical support to produce tiatr in original format for local communities.
schemes.benefits: - Financial Support: Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide financial support to the extent as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa towards various aspects: Direction, Live Band (with at least 2 blowing instruments), Outside Artistes, Stage Setting, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, Light Effects.- Technical Guidance: Provision of director from Tiatr Academy of Goa's Panel of Directors who will direct village talents and produce the tiatr.- Director Expenses: The expenditure incurred in engaging the director will be borne by Tiatr Academy of Goa.- Marketing Materials: Provision of one banner which should be compulsorily displayed on one of the two front side wings of the stage.- Documentation: Tiatr Academy of Goa may video film the performance at Kala Academy.- Observer Support: Tiatr Academy of Goa may depute an observer from its Panel of Observers to see whether the performance has been made as per the norms of the scheme.- Payment Method: Payment will be made directly to the service providers.- Sponsorship Policy: Sponsorship from businessmen, firms etc. may be taken. | Conditions | _The performance of the tiatr should be staged in the village/urban area of production._ | _The tiatr should be shown to the people free without charging any tickets._ | _Submit statement of expenditure enclosing all original bills (stamped receipt if the amount exceeds ₹5,000/-)._ | _Provide 20 invitation cards/entry passes to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance from the middle of rows A, B, or C._ | _Return banner to Tiatr Academy of Goa after the show is staged._ | _Payment will be made only after the receipt of the observer's certificate._
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be an Educational Institution, Cultural Association, Dramatic Troupe, or Individual.; The applicant must be interested in promoting Tiatr culture in the village.; The applicant must be from the particular village/urban area/parish (in case of Mumbai, Sindhudurg and other parts of the country).; The participating artistes must be from the particular village/urban area/parish (Educational Institutions only).; A maximum of 3 artistes from outside the village/urban areas/parish must be allowed to act as well as sing in the tiatr.; The tiatr must be produced in its original format including 6 or 7 acts (podd'dde) with at least 4 'cantos' and comedy linked to the story of the play.; The tiatr must include at least 14 'Kantaram' which includes at least 2 Duets, 1 Duo, 2 Trios, 1 Quartet/Quintet, 2 Choral Songs and Solos.; The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the scripts/lyrics of songs/performances/speeches which may hurt the sentiments of anybody.; The applicant must communicate the schedule of practices to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance.; The applicant must discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide who will be the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour at the performance well in advance.; The applicant must ensure this is the first performance of the tiatr for which financial assistance is sought from Tiatr Academy of Goa.; The script and songs may be written/composed by anyone from within the village or elsewhere but acting and singing must be done by the artistes from the particular village/urban area/parish.; Musicians may be from anywhere and not necessarily from the village.; Advertising Requirements: In all advertisements, oral, or print or electronic media, banners, etc. the following must be inserted/published/announced 'This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa'.

schemes.title: Pension to Widows and Destitute Women
schemes.description: Under this scheme, widows and destitute women aged 18 years and above are eligible for a pension if they are domiciles of Haryana and have been residing in the state for at least one year at the time of application submission.
schemes.benefits: Under this scheme, a pension of ₹2,500/- per month is given to widows and destitute women.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.; The applicant should meet one of the following conditions:; The applicant should be 18 years of age or older.; The applicant's annual income from all sources should be less than ₹2,00,000/-.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Pension To Widows And Destitute Women-Chandigarh
schemes.description: Under the Pension To Widows And Destitute Women scheme To provide financial assistance to Widows and Destitute Women of Chandigarh.
schemes.benefits: Pension Amount To Widows And Destitute Women - ₹1,000/- per month
schemes.eligibility: The applicant women's age should be 18-60 years.; The applicant should be a resident of UT, Chandigarh for more than 3 years.; The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Scheme of Publication Grant/Subsidy for Publication of Doctoral Thesis/Research Report/ Papers Presented in Seminars/Conferences, etc.
schemes.description: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, provides financial assistance for the publication of high-quality doctoral theses, research project/fellowship reports, and seminar/conference papers in the field of social sciences.
schemes.benefits: - Grant up to Rs. 2,00,000 for publishing the approved manuscript. | - Direct payment to the publisher upon submission of required documents. | - Includes cost of printing, editorial work, and production. | - Royalty to be paid to the author (minimum 10% on actual sales). | - ICSSR may purchase additional copies with a 25% discount.
schemes.eligibility: Manuscripts must be based on social science research.; Doctoral theses must be approved within the last 3 years.; The author must have at least one research paper published in a reputed journal.; Reports must be from ICSSR/non-ICSSR-funded projects/fellowships or seminar papers of quality.

schemes.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme “Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu.
schemes.benefits: - All girl students who studied from Classes 6th to 12th in Government schools will be paid ₹1,000/- per month till the completion of their undergraduate degree, diploma, ITI, and any other recognized course. | - The assistance amount under this scheme will be disbursed directly into the student’s Bank Account. | - The students shall be eligible for this in addition to other scholarships.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be residing in the state of Tamil Nadu.; The applicant should be a student.; The applicant should be a female to avail of benefits from this scheme.; All girl students who studied from Classes 6th to 12th in Government schools of Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply under the scheme.; The assistance can be extended to any number of girl students in a family pursuing higher education at recognized Institutions/Colleges/Universities.; The girl students should pursue their education in recognized courses and colleges/universities.; Only the first course of higher education will be considered as an eligible factor.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Purna Aahaara for Children (6 months - 5 years)
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide nutritional support to Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) children. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided Take Home Ration (THR) of 3 kg per month, along with 30 eggs per month, for a duration of 112 days.
schemes.benefits: Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided Take Home Ration (THR) of 3 kg per month, along with 30 eggs per month, for a duration of 112 days from the date of enrollment. | Note: Parents and caregivers are requested to have their children's growth monitored at Anganwadi Centre (AWCs) and take special care of them.
schemes.eligibility: The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha.; The beneficiary must be a child aged between 6 months and 5 years.; The child must be identified as Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) by an Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.

schemes.title: Purchase of Vehicle for Commercial Hiring Purpose for Persons with Disabilities
schemes.description: Under the scheme, loans are provided to differently-abled persons for commercial hiring purposes up to ₹10.00 lakhs, and for the purchase of special category vehicles like JCBs, trucks, road rollers, etc., loans up to ₹25.00 lakhs are available.
schemes.benefits: - Under this scheme, loans are provided to differently abled persons for commercial hiring up to ₹10,000,00/- and for purchasing special category vehicles such as JCB, Trucks, Road rollers, etc., with loans up to ₹25,000,00/-.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.; The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%.; The age of the applicant should be above 18 years. For persons with mental retardation, the age is relaxed to 14 years instead of the usual 18 years.; License is applicable as per the policy of the National Corporation.
schemes.category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance; Business & Entrepreneurship

schemes.title: Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme (DAADC)
schemes.description: The "Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial support to unemployed individuals from Antyodaya Caste for purchasing passenger or freight vehicles.
schemes.benefits: - Financial assistance in the form of a loan.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.; The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.; The applicant must be unemployed.; The applicant must belong to an Antyodaya family.; The applicant must have a family income not exceeding ₹3,00,000/- per annum.

schemes.title: Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti
schemes.description: Under Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti Madhya Pradesh Government aimed at providing financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to these marginalized communities.
