schemes.title: Widow Pension Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
schemes.description: The "Widow Pension Scheme" launched by HPBOCWWB is designed to support widows of registered beneficiaries. Through this initiative, the Board will disburse a monthly amount of ₹1,500/- to help widows manage their expenses and improve their quality of life.
schemes.benefits: Monthly Pension of ₹1,500/-
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be the widow of a deceased construction worker.; The deceased worker should have been registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB).; The deceased worker should have maintained regular membership with the Board.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Widow Pension - Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: Widow pension in Uttar Pradesh is a social welfare scheme by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to widows residing in the state. The scheme is administered by the Women Welfare Department of the state government.
schemes.benefits: Financial Assistance : ₹1,000/- per month
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh state.; The applicant's husband has died.; The age of the applicant should not be less than 18 years.; The annual income of the applicant and her family from all sources should not exceed  ₹ 2,00,000/-

schemes.title: Widow Pension-West Bengal
schemes.description: The West Bengal government's Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department launched the "Widow Pension" scheme in 2010. This program aims to support widows facing economic hardship within the state.
schemes.benefits: - Financials assistance of ₹1,000/- per Month through DBT mode to the beneficiaries.
schemes.eligibility: The beneficiary must be widow girl/woman.; The beneficiary should attain the age of 60 years or more.; The beneficiary must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Bengal.; The beneficiary family income must not exceed ₹ 1,000/- per month.; The beneficiary must not be maintained by any of her relative.; The beneficiary must have been a resident of West Bengal for at least ten years on the date of making the application.; Professional beggars and mendicants are not eligible for the pension.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
schemes.description: The scheme "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced with the objective of assisting fishermen families who are deprived of income during natural calamities and fishing ban periods.
schemes.benefits: 100 kgs. of rice and a cash dole at ₹ 750/- per fishermen's family during the period of ban on fishing during the year.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be an ordinarily resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.; The applicant should be a fisherman.; The applicant should belong to a group designated to be "Below Poverty Line".; *Beneficiary shall also be considered based on the decisions taken periodically by the Governing Body of the Pondicherry Fishermen Welfare and Distress Relief Society.; The applicant should not be ordinarily residing in any foreign nation during the natural calamity, lean season, or ban on the fishing period for which relief assistance is issued.; The beneficiary or any other members of the ration card should not be in regular service in the Government/Quasi Government/Government undertakings/Retired Government Pensioner.

schemes.title: "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
schemes.description: The scheme "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the sudden demise of the breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family.
schemes.benefits: ₹ 1,00,000 as immediate death relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the deceased fisherman, received within 15 days to 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the affected family.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be the family (legal heir) of the deceased fisherman.; The deceased fisherman should have been a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.; The deceased fisherman must have lost his/her life while fishing.; The deceased fisherman must have been in the age group of 18-60 years.; The deceased fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme.; The deceased fisherman should have enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.

schemes.title: Lean Season Assistance under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
schemes.description: The scheme "Lean Season Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced with the objective of assisting fishermen families who are deprived of income during natural calamities and fishing ban periods.
schemes.benefits: 5kg of free rice and one set of clothing consisting of one quality saree with one blouse bit, one lunghie, and one towel per fishermen's family, during natural calamities every year.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be an ordinarily resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.; The applicant should be a fisherman.; The applicant should belong to a group designated to be "Below Poverty Line".; *Beneficiary shall also be considered based on the decisions taken periodically by the Governing Body of the Pondicherry Fishermen Welfare and Distress Relief Society.; The applicant should not be ordinarily residing in any foreign nation during the natural calamity, lean season, or ban on the fishing period for which relief assistance is issued.; The beneficiary or any other members of the ration card should not be in regular service in the Government/Quasi Government/Government undertakings/Retired Government Pensioner.

schemes.title: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BC-A Students
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Backward Classes (BC-A) families to support their education. Under this scheme, eligible students studying in Classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools receive a monthly stipend.
schemes.benefits: A. Admissible Monthly Stipend for BC(A) Girl Students: | - Class 1 to 5: ₹150/- per month | - Class 6 to 8: ₹200/- per month | - Class 9 to 12: ₹300/- per month | - Class 11 to 12 (Science Students only): ₹400/- per month | A. Admissible Monthly Stipend for BC(A) Boy Students: | - Class 1 to 5: ₹75/- per month | - Class 6 to 8: ₹100/- per month | - Class 9 to 12: ₹150/- per month | - Class 11 to 12 (Science Students only): ₹200/- per month | Mode of Disbursement: | Direct transfer to students' bank accounts. | Frequency of Disbursement: | Monthly basis. | Expected Time of Disbursement: | Funds to be transferred at the beginning of each quarter. | Validity: | Applicable for the duration of the academic session. | Attendance criteria: Minimum 50% attendance required for next installment
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should belong to the Backward Classes category (A).; The applicant should be a student from Classes 1 to 12.; The applicant should be enrolled in a Haryana Government school.; The applicant should maintain at least 50% attendance to continue receiving benefits.; The applicant should have an active bank account for stipend transfer.

schemes.title: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public.
schemes.benefits: Compensation for Damaged Nets | Fishermen are paid compensation not exceeding ₹25,000/- (twenty-five thousand rupees) in lieu of nets that are damaged or cut during rescue operations involving trapped Whale Sharks. | Conditions for Benefit Availment/Disbursement | - The rescue operation must be documented through videography or photography for compensation to be paid. | - The fishermen must take photographs of trapped Whale Sharks, release them on the spot, and then submit this information and photographs after returning to the coast to receive their compensation.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a fisherman, particularly from the Kharva and Koli communities residing in the coastal talukas of Veraval, Sutrapada, and Mangrol in Junagadh district.; The applicant's fishing net must incur damage or require cutting during an operation to rescue a trapped Whale Shark.; The applicant, or the rescue team involved, must ensure the rescue operation is thoroughly documented through either videography or photography.; The applicant, under the self-documentation scheme, must photograph the trapped Whale Shark, release it on the spot, and then submit these photographs along with incident details to the Forests and Environment Department after returning to the sea coast.

schemes.title: Women Self Employment Scheme
schemes.description: The "Women Self Employment Scheme" encourages women to become self-reliant and supports their efforts in establishing small-scale industries or trade ventures, thereby improving their economic status & promoting self-employment opportunities across the state providing them financial assistance.
schemes.benefits: - Financial Assistance of ₹5,000/- provides women to help them start small businesses or trade activities.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a woman.; The applicant should set up their own business trade, and small industry to earn their livelihood.; The applicant's annual income does not exceed ₹35,000/-.; Physically handicapped individuals are also eligible to apply under this scheme.

schemes.title: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Widows
schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to widows in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It covers widows who have not remarried and have no source of income.
schemes.benefits: Financial Assistance: | - Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of ₹1,500/- per month (₹18,000 per annum). | Mode of Disbursement: | - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account. | Frequency of Disbursement: | - The pension is disbursed on a monthly basis.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep.; The applicant should be a widow.; The applicant should not have remarried.; The applicant should have only nominal income, not exceeding ₹1,500/- per month (₹18,000/- per annum).; The applicant should not be a beneficiary of any other similar pension scheme provided by the government.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Women and Child

schemes.title: Working Women Hostel
schemes.description: The scheme "Working Women Hostel" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Haryana aims to provide safe and affordable accommodation to working women. Through this scheme, hostel facilities at subsidized rent are provided to employed women.
schemes.benefits: Rental Charges: | - Single Bedrooms: Not exceeding 15% of total emoluments/gross salary. - Double Bedrooms: Not exceeding 10% of total emoluments/gross salary. - Dormitories: Not exceeding 7.5% of total emoluments/gross salary.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a woman.; The applicant should be working individual.

schemes.title: World War II Pension
schemes.description: The aim of the scheme is to provide lifelong financial assistance of ₹15,000/- per month as a measure of relief to World War II ex-servicemen and their widows who are not receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source.
schemes.benefits: Financial Assistance: | - A pension of ₹15,000 per month is provided for a lifetime. | Mode of Disbursement: | - The pension is deposited monthly into the beneficiary’s bank account.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.; The applicant should be either an ex-serviceman who served during World War II (1st September 1939 to 15th August 1945) or his widow.; The applicant should not be receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source.

schemes.title: Yatra Anudan
schemes.description: The scheme aims to support researchers and scientists in attending international scientific workshops and other programs by providing eligible applicants with travel grants covering up to 50% of the expenses (maximum ₹25,000/-).
schemes.benefits: - The Council provides travel grants to researchers and scientists to participate in international scientific workshops and other similar programs. | - Under this scheme, 50% of the travel expenses (up to a maximum of ₹25,000/-) are provided to researchers and scientists of the state.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.; The applicant must be a researcher or scientist.

schemes.title: Young Achievers Awards
schemes.description: The scheme aims to recognize young talented artistes who have contributed and continue to work for the development of tiatr, its song and music, and have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Song through All India Radio, Doordarshan and other platforms at national and international levels.
schemes.benefits: Award Components: The Young Achievers Award consists of a memento, a Citation and a Cash Burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. | Recognition Ceremony: Selected artistes are honoured at a special function on 16th November on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Regina Fernandes, the First Lady of the Tiatr Stage. | Annual Awards: The award is given to a male and a female artiste every year. | _*The selected artistes must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award._
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be not more than 35 years of age.; The applicant must have contributed in the field of tiatr for at least 10 years.; The applicant must have performed in at least 15 tiatrs.; The applicant's contribution should be considered in areas such as acting, script writing, directing, singing, lyricist work, set designing, etc.; The applicant's contribution as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer, etc.; The applicant should have received or won any awards in his/her field.; The applicant should have done any innovation on the tiatr stage.; The applicant, if a singer/musician, should have songs recorded on Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs, All India Radio, Doordarshan, online, etc.; The applicant should have acted/directed/sung/composed music/composed lyrics/designed sets/provided background music/designed light effects for dramas in other languages or in films.; The applicant, if script writer or lyricist, should have published any books of his/her scripts/lyrics.; The applicant, if a writer/director, should have written/directed at least 7 tiatrs.; The applicant's contribution in acting/singing/providing live music/stage setting/background music, providing lights, as a makeup artiste should be at least for 10 years and should have performed in at least 15 tiatrs.

schemes.title: Youth Art Training Fellowship Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage youth in arts by providing a monthly fellowship and professional training through government institutions.
schemes.benefits: - Monthly training fellowship of ₹10,000 per selected participant. | - Professional art training at government-recognized art and music institutions (Page No. 3).- Certification after successful completion of training. | - Opportunity to receive structured guidance in classical, tribal, and folk art forms. | - The fellowship is valid only for the approved training period of 3 months.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.; The applicant should be interested in training in one art discipline such as singing, instrumental music, dance, theatre, painting, or crafts.; The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age.

schemes.title: Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs
schemes.description: The scheme "Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs," was launched by the Dept of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt of Maharashtra. Each VJNT family will receive a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5,382 square feet).
schemes.benefits: - Each family is provided with a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5,382 square feet). | - This plot of land will include the construction of a 269-square-foot home, forming a cluster of 20 families. | - The project will also cover the essential amenities, including shelter, internal roads, drainage, water supply, electricity, and a community hall (Samaj Mandir) for social activities. | - The entire project aims to improve the living standards of VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) families by offering them stable housing and related amenities. | - The benefit of this scheme is given every year to 3 villages amongst 34 districts (except Mumbai & B. Mumbai) to 20 families. | _The land for the house shall be given under this scheme on the names of the husband and wife jointly. However, in the case of widow and divorcee, land and house shall be given by their name._ | _The land allotted under this scheme is non-transferable, it will not be sold to anyone. The house or land should not be given on rent._
schemes.eligibility: The family of the applicant should be residing in Maharashtra.; The family of the applicant should belong to the original VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) category.; The family of the applicant should not be having their own house.; The family of the applicant should be residing in a tent house or hut.; The family of the applicant should be landless.; The family of the applicant should be residing in one place for at least six months and, for the remaining months, should be wandering from village to village for livelihood.; The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than ₹1,00,000/-.; The family of the applicant should not have availed of the benefits of any other housing scheme such as Gharkul etc.; The benefit of this scheme will be given to one member only of the eligible family.
schemes.category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Housing & Shelter; Transport & Infrastructure

schemes.title: Youth and Eco Club
schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote environmental awareness and sustainable practices among students by organizing programmes and activities such as plastic reduction initiatives, kitchen gardening, etc. along with various competitions to engage and empower students in protecting the environment.
schemes.benefits: Under the Youth and Eco Club in schools, awareness programmes, competitions, and activities were organized on plastic reduction, kitchen gardening, tree plantation, environmental protection, waste management, cleanliness, and water conservation, etc. | - Bagless Day and Environment Friendly Awareness. | - Awareness Through Skits and Plays. | - Poster makings, Paintings, Slogan writing etc. Competition and "Say No" to Single Use plastic. | - Cleaning Drives of the School and Surrounding and Keeping Toilets Usable. | - Composting Food Waste in the School. | - Planting of Trees in Schools.
schemes.eligibility: All primary, upper primary, and secondary government schools in Uttarakhand are eligible.

schemes.title: Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS)
schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to empower young people and youth organisations by providing financial support for development activities. It aims to encourage youth participation in community service, sports, cultural events, and leadership initiatives across Meghalaya.
schemes.benefits: - Financial assistance of up to INR 1.00 lakh per financial year may be sanctioned to eligible youth organisations or individuals. | - Up to 10% of the total applications may receive a higher amount of financial support.
schemes.eligibility: The organisation should be a registered society, trust, charitable organisation, Section 8 company, or not-for-profit entity under the Societies Registration Act of 1860 for at least 3 months.; The organisation should maintain financial accounts with a clear framework for effective and transparent management.; The organisation should have primary beneficiaries under the age of 35 and be open to all citizens of the state without distinction of religion, race, caste, or language.; The organisation should have at least 50% of registered members under the age of 35 as of the application date.; The organisation should not be blacklisted or barred by any government or private entity and should have no pending or ongoing litigation related to misconduct, misappropriation of funds, or sexual harassment.; The applicant should be a citizen of Meghalaya and under the age of 35 as of the application date.; The applicant should have a bank account in their name (single or joint account).; The applicant should be able to provide proof of selection for the competition or event for which the grant is being requested.

schemes.title: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
schemes.description: This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidates, for an initial period of support of 2 years, extendible till 5 years based on performance review.
schemes.benefits: Nature of Support: | - Research Fellowship: ₹20,000/- per month, in addition to the regular salary - Research Contingency Grant: ₹5,00,000/- per year for a maximum of 5 years - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institution. | - Research Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipment, consumables and domestic travel. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for YFRF. | - The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. | - YFRFs are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution though which YFRF proposal was submitted. | Duration of Support: | - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment, and is tenable for a maximum period of 05 years. | - The award will initially be for 2 years and further extendible, based on performance review.
schemes.eligibility: Appropriate progress is not being made.; The grant is not being utilized properly.; Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines.; Any other reason, which is deemed appropriate by PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY.

schemes.title: Youth Hostel Scheme
schemes.description: The Youth Hostel Scheme is a joint venture of the Central and State Governments of India. It was launched in the early 1960s to promote youth travel within the country by providing low-cost budget accommodation and facilities to students and youth groups traveling on excursions or study tours.
schemes.benefits: - Affordable accommodation: Youth hostels offer a much cheaper alternative to hotels and guesthouses.1. Social atmosphere: Youth hostels are a great place to meet new people from all over the world.1. Cultural experience: Youth hostels are often located in places of cultural interest, giving you the opportunity to learn about the local culture and traditions.1. Flexible options: Youth hostels offer a variety of accommodation options, including dormitories, private rooms, and family rooms. You can also choose to book meals at the hostel or cook your own food.
schemes.eligibility: There is no age restriction but if applicant is below 18 then he/she  must be accompanied by a parent or guardian when staying in a youth hostel.

schemes.title: Young Interns Program
schemes.description: The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship program, envisaged by the Government of Rajasthan, for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programs, schemes and projects of the government departments.
schemes.benefits: Stipend | ₹ 30,000/- per month. | Laptop Connectivity and Mobility Support | ₹ 2500/- shall be paid to each intern per month. | Leaves | Every intern will be eligible for one casual leave every month on an accrual basis. Such leaves shall be provided in a cumulative manner i.e. 12 leaves for the entire year (from January to December).
schemes.eligibility: The age of the applicant should be between 21 years and 30 years.; The applicant should have excellent communication/presentation/intra–personal skills/soft skills.; The applicant should have good Knowledge of English as well as Hindi language (Reading, Speaking, Writing and Understanding); The applicant should have well-versed ICT skills and knowledge of MS Office and other similar programs on alternative platforms.; It is mandatory for all the interns to have their own Laptop and data card/internet facility.; The applicant should have a post-graduate qualification with a minimum of 60% marks or a CGPA of 6 on a scale of 10 in any stream from a recognized university.; The graduate applicant of Engineering/Medical/Law/CA/CS Streams from a recognized University with a minimum 60% mark or a CGPA of 6 on a scale of 10 shall also be eligible for this internship.; The applicant with working experience in the field of his/her choice of department shall be given priority.

schemes.title: Young Investigators Programme in Biotechnology
schemes.description: The programme “Young Investigator’s Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB)” is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology.
schemes.benefits: - Young Scientists without fellowship/salary are eligible for a fellowship of ₹45,000/- plus 10% HRA per month, in addition to the support for travel, contingency, consumables, and minor equipment. | - A Principal Investigator having a regular position can seek manpower. | - Maximum support up to ₹30 lakhs (excluding overhead charges @ 10% of the project cost subject to a ceiling of ₹ 1.0 lakh) for a period not exceeding three years.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should possess a Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences.; The applicant should possess three years of post-doctoral experience in Biotechnology.; The applicant should be less than 40 years of age.

schemes.title: Yuvak Mangal Dal and Mahila Mangal Dal Swavalamban Yojana
schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among village-level male and female youth groups (Mangal Dals) by providing financial support for the purchase of essential materials, enabling them to become self-reliant and undertake community-based activities.
schemes.benefits: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹14,268/- is provided to purchase essential materials for community use, aimed at making the Mangal Dals self-reliant.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a recognized Yuvak Mangal Dal or Mahila Mangal Dal in Uttarakhand, formally affiliated with the Department of Youth Welfare and PRD, Government of Uttarakhand.

schemes.title: Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers
schemes.description: The "Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides a pass of ₹ 2400/- per three months for non AC DTC bus to the registered workers for purchasing.
schemes.benefits: - A pass of 2400/- per three months for non AC DTC bus is provided.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.; The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker.; The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.; The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.; The applicant should be above 5 years of age.

schemes.title: Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)
schemes.description: The scheme "Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)" is designed to honour the young Goan individuals who have excelled in the field of Art and culture in Goa. The scheme intends to give recognition to young artists par excellence for their outstanding achievements.
schemes.benefits: - A memento, certificate of appreciation and financial purse to the extent of ₹ 25,000/- per individual.1. Every year a maximum of 6 persons in the fields of Music/Dance, Drama/Tiatr, Folk Art, Photography/Painting, Craft, Sculpture, Bhajan/Kirtan, Literature, and Film shall be considered.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be an individual artist.; The age of the applicant should be between 25 and 40 years. Only in exceptional cases, the minimum & maximum age could be relaxed by upto 5 years.; The applicant should have given extraordinary contributions in the field of Art and culture at large in his/ her respective field of art in specific.; The applicant should have contributed to his/her respective field of art in Goa for a minimum 5 years out of his/her career as a; practising artist.; No award will be presented posthumously under this scheme. However, during the selection process if the death of any artist occurs after the recommendation of his name then the Task Force Committee may consider his name for the award, in such circumstances, the award will be presented posthumously.

schemes.title: Yuvasree Prakalpa
schemes.description: "Yuvasree" was launched in 2013 by Labor Department, Government of West Bengal for providing financial assistance to jobseekers.
schemes.benefits: - Cash Benefits: Subject to fulfillment of the aforesaid eligibility criteria an individual may receive unemployment assistance under the scheme ₹ 1500/- per month.- Job Seeking: By registering in Employment Bank, beneficiaries can search and apply for jobs per their skills.- Training Program: The recipient can upgrade his/her skill subsequently under any of the Skill Development programs of the state government / private training institutes and increase his/her employability. The training program shall include soft skills training, basic IT training, basic communication training, and other skill as per the need or the interest of the beneficiary.- Placement Support: Assistance in placing the candidate in a Government or Private organization.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.; The applicant must be unemployed.; The applicant should be enrolled with the Employment Bank as a ‘job seeker’.; The applicant should be class 8th pass and above.; The applicant should be between 18-45 years of age on the 1st day of April of the year in which he/she is considered under the scheme.; The applicant had not to availed financial assistance /loan under any state/central government sponsored Self-Employment scheme.; Only one member of a family is eligible to receive assistance under the scheme.

schemes.title: Dr. Y.V. Singh Award for Best Thesis in Vegetable Science
schemes.description: The scheme aims to recognize and encourage students for their outstanding research work in the field of Vegetable Science. Under this, a cash award of ₹20,000/- is provided annually to the selected students.
schemes.benefits: Award Amount: ₹20,000/- per year.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant must be a student of Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar.; The applicant must have submitted a thesis in the field of Vegetable Science at the university.; The award is granted for a period of one year only.

schemes.title: Yoga Wellness Center
schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote holistic health and wellness among people of all age groups through yoga, naturopathy, and personalized counseling.
schemes.benefits: Under this scheme, Yoga, naturopathy, and counseling services are provided based on the individual’s health condition. For this, the OPD fee is ₹1.00 per person in rural areas and ₹2.00 per person in urban areas.
schemes.eligibility: The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.; The beneficiary can belong to any age group.; The beneficiary must be registered at an identified Government Ayurvedic Centre or Hospital.

schemes.title: Zero Budget Natural Farming
schemes.description: The Rajasthan State government started a scheme "Zero Budget Natual Farming" in 2020-21 to promote natural farming.
schemes.benefits: - A subsidy of 50% provides to farmers to buy the farming items. | - A large drum of 200 litres, a small drum of 50 litres capacity, a bucket of 20 litres capacity, a Jug, filter, water spray, sprayer, Trichoderma, cow-urine, dung, etc. Material and organic mulch material like leaves of trees, weed bedding, leaves of millet-sorghum, etc., groundnut peels, and in the field for moisture conservation between the rows, 50% of the total cost of available other waste material or a maximum of Rs.600/- per farmer will be given as subsidy by DBT. | - Training and Farmers Tours. | - Gram Panchayat level Training.
schemes.eligibility: Interested farmers should be selected for the scheme who have a special interest in natural farming. Every farmer must have a minimum of one-acre land ownership or family account holder.; Interested farmers may be from the same village, neighboring villages, or different villages as far as possible.; Interested farmers will be selected by the Regional Assistant Agriculture Officer / Agriculture Supervisor.; Horticulture crops and animal husbandry should also be included in natural farming.; For the selection of farmers, priority should be given to SC, ST, BPL, small and marginal farmers as much as possible. Youths up to 35 years should be included for natural farming so that their capacity can increase.; Necessary material like drum, bucket, jug etc. will be given on grant to the concerned farmer for setting up the input unit for natural farming.; Farmers selected under Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana should not be included in this scheme.

schemes.title: Zupda Vijlikaran Yojana
schemes.description: Under this scheme, free household electricity connections are given to the BPL /Lower income group households across the state.
schemes.benefits: - Free electricity household connection is provided to BPL/Lower income group beneficiary.
schemes.eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.; The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) or low-income family.; The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.
